title: Structured covariance or projection-product gap
statement: After the sealed route card is frozen, formulate the weakest structured covariance-map or symmetrized projection-product gap that directly implies C050, while allowing a multi-epoch block and without invoking C051.

signature.representation: Energy-coordinate covariance lift as a structured symmetrized product, or an equivalent full second-moment block power
signature.state_or_invariant: A cone-compatible operator gap with controlled non-normal prefactor
signature.core_candidate_lemma: The RPCD-specific projection family has a weak symmetrized-product or block-power gap proportional to mu on the required invariant state space.
information_discarded: a scalar frame floor without coordinate structure
signature.target_implication: A block-power gap with a uniform prefactor yields the C050 expected-distance estimate directly, even if C051 is false or unavailable.
signature.known_failure_mode: The generic noncommutative AGM and a natural remaining-frame inverse potential are too strong; a candidate that implies either has probably discarded essential RPCD structure.
signature.verifier_class: exact structured projection products and independent covariance-power regression controls
